comments.value: Another good idea would be for it to autogenerate a simple Note for the person you're friending/acquainting with too, like "met on 26Feb2023 @19:42 in world "X"

another idea would be more/unlimited Friend groups (stored locally to not have a impact on the API and in a file you can backup).

That way you could sort your friends in whatever way you want. 

The 3 friend Groups are not enough. And then when clicking on someone, the friend group they are in should be visibly represented in their page on the small menu.

The next step would be to be able to give the group a color that will then be represented on the nametag.
@{63bbf2352923266486f97083|full_name}: YES!!!!! I have been keeping that information manually now for years.
@{63bbf2352923266486f97083|full_name}: that would be also interesting. the exact time and date you befriended someone and the world (if you are in the same world in that moment).

I like the idea.

I hope the friend/acquaintance is only visible to you, not others. Can you imagine the drama if people saw who you listed as friends vs acquaintances?

Yes too many time do I meet folk on my friends list that I do not remember having added. It's gotten so bad that i now have a rule against adding someone as a friend until I meet them for the third or fourth time.

I liked High Fidelitys friend system. When you add each other you are first "contacts" and you would mark individuals as "friends", so you could set up so only your "friends" could join you immediately but "contacts" has to request to join.

I made this a while ago :7

https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/add-acquaintance-mode-for-friends-change-friend-request-to-contact-request
Yes, please. This would be very very helpful.

It would be really good to have a more finely grained friendship system yes.

Like, "acquaintances", "followers", "special friends", with various permissions sets for each . For instance a follower could only find you and join you if you are blue, but they cannot see if you are online or not if you are not blue. An acquaintance could join you if you are blue, but would still have to request if you are green. They would be able to see if you are online, though. Special friends would be able to join you when you are green, without asking.

I see this very useful for content creators, djs, hosts, event organisers, dancers, etc etc. Right now we have to constantly hide behind an alt or orange status to be able to enjoy some moments with close friends without being joined or asked by people who we friended only for the purposes of events or content promotion. It hinders our true friends from joining us, and I think it is quite unfair.

I hear people saying "oh yes but then people will bitch because they won't like being just an acquaintance", but I think that is simply what happens for all kind of people with some exposure. Usually we don't have our favourite singer's or actor's email or phone number right ?  But we can still follow them on social media.

Maybe "contacts" would be a nicer way to say it.

With vrc being a highly social platform, I think this basic feature is really missing.
@{608eb83a22fecc6799c7d73f|full_name} Yes thank you for keeping this alive. This perfectly describes the issue! Please do something about this VRC!

This would would be amazing. The current system just causes a slew of orange users, including myself, because of people that I add as CONTACTS, that I can visit again, but I do NOT want them joining me at will on green. This is ridiculous and long over due for a overhaul. The friend system needs to change.

I'd argue there's already a poor implementation with orange status also hiding what world I'm in? Why does orange status also behave like i'm in a private instance. I set myself on orange to stop people from joining WIHTOUT ASKING, not to hide what I'm doing, that's what private instances are for. 

At best you MUST separate JOIN permission from visibility. We should have 2 statuses. 1. Join freely/not freely & 2. World visible/not visible. Separate the function.

This is still a major issue in my opinion. At the very least, let us mark people as acquaintances, and require them to send an invite request when we're on green. That's the bare minimum and would already be a major improvement, I think.

details: Too often do you hear people say I friended you, but I have no clue who you are or where we met. Ask yourself, is that really the definition of a friend? For too long I have really wanted VRC to implement a whole new tag that is in between friend and not friend. We need for example a blue name that can be called acquaintance. Someone that you just met, or a friend of a friend. This way you can more easily mark people that you have met before, interacted with, but are not quite friends just yet. Please VRC, PLEASE implement something like this!
title: Need something between friend and not friend
